info.name: Shadowstalker Conclave
info.description: Ranger archetype for stealthy ambush hunters (Shadowstalker Conclave)
info.author: hibrahimylmz

description.p: Shadowstalkers are elusive hunters who walk the knife-edge between predator and phantom. They combine nature's attunement, relentless pursuit, and cunning lethality—striking from concealment and vanishing before retaliation.

sheet.description: Elusive ambusher: bonus hide, stealth expertise, precision damage, and mobility-focused high-level options.

description.p: Your bond with the wild grants you spells tailored for deception, infiltration, and sudden strikes. These spells are always prepared for you and do not count against your prepared spells. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

sheet.description: You always have Shadowstalker spells prepared (Wisdom is your spellcasting ability; spell save DC {{shadowstalker:dc}}, spell attack +{{shadowstalker:attack}}).

description.p: You gain proficiency in Stealth. If you are already proficient, your proficiency bonus is doubled for Stealth. In addition, you can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

sheet.description: Gain Stealth proficiency or expertise. Hide is a bonus action for you.

description.p: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a finesse or ranged weapon attack and you have advantage (or an ally is within 5 feet of the target and not incapacitated), you deal extra damage.

sheet.description: Cunning Strike: +1d6 on qualifying hit (scales with level).

description.p: When you are subjected to an effect that allows a Dexterity saving throw to take half damage, you instead take no damage on a success and only half damage on a failure.

sheet.description: Evasion: No damage on successful Dex save, half on failure.

description.p: When you take the Attack action, you can make one additional attack as a bonus action. That bonus attack can benefit from Cunning Strike even if you've already used it this turn, but you can't apply Cunning Strike to the same target more than once in a turn.

sheet.description: When taking the Attack action, make one extra attack as a bonus action (Cunning Strike may apply).

description.p: When an attacker you can see hits you, you can use your reaction to halve the damage.

sheet.description: Use your reaction to halve damage from an attacker you can see.

description.p: You have advantage on initiative rolls. In the first round of combat, the first creature you hit becomes marked until the start of your next turn; all attack rolls against the marked target have advantage.

p.em: Optional replacement for level 6 ranger features

description.p: Your walking speed increases by 10 feet. If you have a climbing or swimming speed, those also increase by 10 feet.

p.em: Optional replacement for level 10 ranger features

description.p: Add your Wisdom modifier to initiative. On the first turn of combat your walking speed increases by 10 feet. If you take the Attack action that turn you can make one additional attack; on a hit with that attack deal an extra 1d8 weapon damage.

While in dim light or darkness, you are invisible to creatures relying on darkvision. This invisibility ends if you attack or cast a spell, but resumes at the start of your next turn if you remain in dim light or darkness.
When you hit a creature with a weapon attack while hidden, deal an extra 3d8 weapon damage. If this reduces the target to 0 hit points, you can immediately attempt to Hide as part of the same action.
